_: The apps the SideStore source lists (ci/sidestore_source.py): each from this repository's releases tagged <tag>-<n> that carry an .ipa asset. Terra's own (since Nov 4, 2026, painting-company row 217) comes from toys.yml as terra-build-<n>; adrift.yml and toys.yml each regenerate the source from here (an app with no release yet is left out). No other toy is listed: the toys Terra holds ship inside it, and the rest have no app (since Nov 16, 2026).

apps.name: Terra Incognita
apps.subtitle: The world, and the toys on it
apps.localizedDescription: The whole Earth as satellites saw it this month, and on it a living light for each of the toys, each where its thing really happens: starlings in Somerset, fireflies in the Smokies, the swell at Nazaré, a river on the Beni, frost on a window at Oymyakon. Touch one and fall into it. Offline; every dataset credited.

apps.name: Adrift
apps.subtitle: Glass floats on the real sea
apps.localizedDescription: Tap the open sea and it rings; rest a beat longer and a glass float is yours, lamp amber on a cool sea. The month's real currents and winds, measured by drifting buoys, carry it; nothing scripts where it goes. Written from scratch in Rust on the GPU. Offline; every dataset credited.
